hooks.name: Block terraform apply from agent
hooks.description: Apply discipline (.kiro/steering/delegation-and-safety.md). Logic in .kiro/hooks/block-terraform-apply.sh (tested by scripts/test_block_terraform_apply_hook.ps1): blocks terraform destroy and any terraform apply except a single, unchained apply of a saved *.approved.tfplan created after the user agreed to the plan. Subagents are plan-only.
